Kanto animation and head portrait credits
Source: https://github.com/PMDCollab/SpriteCollab

Species: all 151 original Kanto Pokemon, national dex #001 through #151.
Original Pokemon Mystery Dungeon artwork: CHUNSOFT.
Community contributors are listed below; individual asset histories preserve
the exact artists, animation/emotion names and license entries per species.
This index includes all contributors in those histories, including states
not used by this game. Author name/contact mappings: credit_names.txt.

Battle sheets and histories: assets/directional/{dex}-{state}.png and
assets/directional/{dex}-credits.txt (un-padded dex numbers).
Head portraits: assets/portraits/{dex}.png (Normal emotion, unaltered).
Portrait histories: assets/portraits/{dex}-credits.txt.
States used: Idle, Walk, Attack, Shoot, Charge, Hurt, Sleep; source aliases
are resolved to their underlying animation. PNGs are re-encoded without
changing pixel art; XML timings, shadow anchors and head offsets are
extracted for rendering. Original files remain in art-source/directional.

SpriteCollab community contributions use CC BY-NC 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/
License text and warranty disclaimer: assets/directional/LICENSE.md.
Original Pokemon characters and artwork remain the property of their owners.
This is a noncommercial fan prototype.
